programme.desc: The team from Mainz is defending itself against relegation from the Bundesliga, but at the halfway point of the regular phase of the Conference League it had all the points and was guaranteed promotion to the play-off phase. Kolejorz is facing a difficult ordeal, but if he managed to win, he would also be sure of playing in the rest of the competition.

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Raków Częstochowa – HSK Zrinjski Mostar
programme.desc: The peace in the Medalik camp was disturbed by information about the possible departure of coach Marek Papszun to Legia Warszawa. In this situation, gaining three points in the match against Zrinjski Mostar may be a challenge for Raków Częstochowa

programme.title: Football: Conference League. SK Sigma Olomouc – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: Kolejorz is one step away from securing a place in the knockout phase of the LK. If they win, they may even go directly to the 1/8 finals. The Polish champion sees a chance for this in the competition with Sigma Olomouc. The Czech team has been performing very poorly lately, as evidenced by 4 defeats in a row and only one goal scored.

programme.title: Football: Conference League. AZ Alkmaar – Jagiellonia Białystok
programme.desc: The pride of Podlasie, despite a 1-2 defeat against Rayo Vallecano in the previous round, can still take a place in the top 8 at the end of the regular phase of the Conference League, and as a result, directly advance to the 1/8 finals. However, it must defeat away AZ Alkmaar, currently the sixth team in the Dutch Eredivisie, and also count on favorable results in other matches

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Omonia FC – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: The Medals are one of three teams in the Conference League that have not yet been defeated in the regular round. The Częstochowa team has already secured their place in the knockout phase, but they do not intend to be satisfied with that. They are counting on direct promotion to the 1/8 finals, which will give them a place in the best eight at the end of the league phase of the competition. Before the clash with Omonia, coached by former Legia coach Henning Berg, they are in third place in the table. The team from Nicosia is fifteenth and has eight points, three less than Raków

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Legia Warszawa – Lincoln Red Imps FC

However, they still have the last match in the Conference League, in which they have no chance of advancing to the knockout phase. However, they will want to end 2025 with a victory against Lincoln Red Imps FC

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Jagiellonia Białystok – KuPS Kuopio
programme.desc: At the halfway point of the regular phase of the Conference League, Pride of Podlasie is in thirteenth place, which guarantees seeding in the play-off phase. Adrian Siemieniec's players remain undefeated, but they cannot be proud of their last performance. They only drew 1-1 with Macedonian Shkendija and scored the equalizing goal in the tenth minute of added time. Jagiellonia has a match against KuPS Kuopio, which, like itself, has five points. The team from Finland will take the field in Białystok encouraged by their 3-1 victory over Slovan Bratislava in the previous round

programme.title: Football: Conference League. FC Noah – Legia Warszawa

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Forests: mysterious lands – Tropical forests | E01
programme.desc: The richest and most diverse forests on Earth will be presented. From the tropics to both poles. Viewers will learn how they provide living conditions for animals. Animal species living in tropical forests along the equator will be presented. Viewers will see, among others, sloths and elephants taking care of their gardens. Netherlands. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Eoin Warner Presents: The Wild Islands of Ireland – The Sea of ​​Snakes | S01E01
programme.desc: Presenter and lover of Irish nature, Eoin Warner, sets sail for the Atlantic. Traveling aboard a 140-year-old ship. Presenter and nature lover, Eoin Warner, introduces viewers to the charms of the western islands of Ireland. In this episode he observes guillemots and hares in Rathlin. Then he goes to the Tora area to admire basking sharks, dolphins, and the love dance of common corncrakes, an endangered species. The team also follows the trail of adorable stoats around Achill. Ireland. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Australia: animal rescue – Jack – rhomboid python | E02
programme.desc: Dr Bree and her team at Byron Bay Wildlife Hospital rescue Australian animals in need of help. They treat a variety of creatures, from tiny echidnas to koalas and kangaroos. A diamond python named Jack had a bad encounter with a tractor and needs urgent surgery. Prickles the echidna was hit by a car. Dr. Bree needs to fix her dislocated paw. Australia. 2021. documentary series

programme.desc: Jeremy Wade travels the world and looks at the strangest, most terrifying fish that inhabit rivers. He talks to people who survived the encounter with water monsters. Jeremy Wade, an amateur of extreme fishing, continues his travels around the world in search of the most dangerous freshwater fish. Today he comes across another terrifying specimen. USA. 2011. documentary series

programme.desc: Filmmakers observe distant corners of the North American continent. In each episode they go to a different part of this land. With a camera, they observe the life of animals from various local ecosystems, from coastal waters to the air. Filmmakers observe distant corners of the North American continent. This time they will learn about the wild nature of Alaska, the Arctic and local representatives of fauna. Viewers will see, among others: a meal of polar bears and a hunt of bald eagles. programme.desc: The north face of the Eiger Mountain is the most famous peak in the history of extreme mountaineering. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Australian lobster fishermen 4 | S04E05
programme.desc: Viewers have the opportunity to observe the daily struggles of six fishing boat captains. Brave lobster fishermen do everything to catch enough of these most sought-after seafood so that they can earn good money and live with dignity. They often compete with each other, such as skipper Squizzy and Bryce. Terrible weather means that the crew of the Chieftain cutter has their hands full. Squizzy contacts a secret informant to obtain confidential information. The Jager fishing dynasty is going through a serious crisis. Australia. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers 5 | S05E12
programme.desc: Another series of the program that tells the story of the struggles of three teams of searchers. They go to Western Australia and try to find deposits of valuable metal there. During their work, they have to face numerous problems and equipment failures. Poseidon Crew members hope to find gold in the bush. Gold Gypsies make a difficult decision. The Victoria Diggers are beginning to believe that their efforts will soon pay off. Australia. 2020. documentary series

programme.desc: Ireland located on the islands will be presented. From its wild coastlines, mountains and forests to farms, cities and towns. Ireland. 2022. documentary series

programme.desc: A story about a legendary land known from western movies. Documentarians present extraordinary landscapes dominated by sun-baked deserts, red rocks of canyons and rocky gorges. However, you can also find huge snow-covered mountains here... Great Britain. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Steve Backshall: Vertical Mile – On the Edge | E02
programme.desc: The north face of the Eiger Mountain is the most famous peak in the history of extreme mountaineering. It is 3,970 m high and, despite its relatively low height, gives chills to the best climbers in the world. Her name is Steve Backshall and her team conquer the peak of Mount Eiger, one of the most dangerous in the world. Blinding blizzards, ice covering the rocks, bitter cold, physical exhaustion and an approaching storm force the group to race against time to save the expedition. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Giants That Are No More 2 – Mysteries of the Titanosaurs | S02E01
programme.desc: The program reveals the secrets of the largest beasts that have ever lived on our planet. Viewers will look at deadly tyrannosaurs, saber-toothed tigers and sea monsters. The latest research will reveal, among other things, how these giant animals evolved, why they were so large and what caused their extinction. Tyrannosaurs are the largest animals that have ever lived on our planet. Paleontologists study their fossils to find out why they were able to grow to such sizes. Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them the advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

But there are teams that, due to their trajectory and their way of falling, have gone down in history despite not lifting the trophy. This is the case of Espanyol in the 1988 UEFA, which lost on penalties against Bayer Leverkusen, and of Alavés in the 2001 UEFA, which was defeated 5-4 by Liverpool with a golden goal in its own goal. Raúl tells us the story of those two modest teams that, against all odds, reached their first European final, eliminating the greats of Europe. Two unforgettable deeds etched in the hearts of their fans

programme.title: Football according to Raúl (T1): Almost Champions
programme.desc: «ReportReport Plus+ (20/21): Channels. The 10» Sergio Canales has become a classic in our league, despite being only 30 years old. From his beginnings at Racing Santander and subsequent transfer to Madrid to his settlement at Betis, his career has been a battle to finally find his place in Seville. With three torn ligaments in his knees, none of what is happening to him today would have happened without a plan. Recover your job through work, technology and a diet adapted to your genetics

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Minister of Defense
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Lost Treasures of Egypt. The Lost Tomb of Cleopatra
programme.desc: In this film we follow archaeologists searching for the tomb of Queen Cleopatra. A team of underwater archaeologists descends to the bottom of the Mediterranean Sea to examine the sunken ruins of ancient Alexandria. Another team transports several 4,000-year-old mummies to a hospital to scan them for treasure. An archaeologist with knowledge of the specifics of legal proceedings discovers a secret network of tunnels in an abandoned temple that will allow her to win the jackpot - finding the tomb of the last pharaoh of Egypt. Dir.: Gwyn Williams, Mat Stimpson, Andy Bailey. Cast: Julian Barratt, Alejandro Jimenez-Serrano, John Ward, Colleen Darnell, John Darnell, Maria Nilsson, Chris Nonton, Salima Ikram, Aliaa Ismail, Iwona Kozieradzka-Ogunmakin. Led by: Julian Barratt, Rick Robles. UK, 2019

programme.title: d/s Lost Treasures of Egypt. Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: Along the western border of the Valley of the Kings lies one of the last remaining unexcavated burial sites. This season, American Egyptologist Don Ryan works tirelessly to conduct a forensic examination of the contents of Tomb 49, hoping to find treasures left behind by ancient robbers. His team makes an incredible discovery - a ring from one of the great Egyptian pharaohs - Ramses III, which is 3000 years old. This forced Don to change the course of his research and lifted the veil of secrecy over the amazing history of state-sanctioned burial plunder on an industrial basis. Not far from the Valley of the Kings, in the necropolis of Deir el Bahari, a team of Spanish archaeologists led by Antonio Morales is studying the ingenious ways in which ancient builders protected their creations from possible plunder. Not far from the tomb of the great ruler Ili, a team of archaeologists has excavated a burial chamber and is examining a rare find of 56 vessels containing embalming materials. What was left of the robbers and early explorers turned out to be one of the greatest treasures of modern times, as the discovery sheds light on the mysteries of the mummification ritual. The fight against tomb robbers continues today. In Cairo, Dr. Shabaan of the Ministry of Culture is working with the US Department of Homeland Security to investigate three ancient mummy fragments being offered for sale on the black market in New York. Will Dr. Shabaan be able to return these remains to their homeland of Egypt? Dir.: Gwyn Williams, Mat Stimpson, Andy Bailey. Cast: Julian Barratt, Alejandro Jimenez-Serrano, John Ward, Colleen Darnell, John Darnell, Maria Nilsson, Chris Nonton, Salima Ikram, Aliaa Ismail, Iwona Kozieradzka-Ogunmakin. Led by: Julian Barratt, Rick Robles. UK, 2019

programme.desc: The film reveals fear as a basic and primitive emotion in the animal world. It is a key survival mechanism, creating vigilance and helping to avoid threats. Learn how fear helps animals navigate dangerous environments and cope with the unknown, and how this emotion is hardwired into their genes to ensure their survival

programme.title: d/f Cheetah. From hunter to prey
programme.desc: This program takes us into the world of wildlife, where cheetahs are constantly fighting for survival. We will see their life path from cubs to adults, reveal the peculiarities of daytime hunting and learn how much strength speed takes away, as a result of which other predators often take away the cheetah’s prey. The survival of the fastest beast on Earth involves overcoming many difficulties, and this struggle cannot but inspire admiration. The cheetah is a perfect creature, the fastest land animal among mammals. Of all the representatives of the cat family, this animal is one of the most adapted to life in its habitat, the African savannah. Thanks to its impeccable aerodynamic body structure with an incredibly flexible back, powerful muscles and long legs, the cheetah reaches speeds of over one hundred kilometers per hour in a few seconds! A rather massive tail allows it to change direction with lightning speed in pursuit of ungulates running in zigzags, and an intensely working heart and lungs make it possible to run at top speeds. Spain, 2016

programme.title: d/f Belovezhskaya Pushcha
programme.desc: The first time you enter Belovezhskaya Pushcha as an ordinary park, the Master, the rightful owner. You breathe greedily in the resinous air until your head hurts, you break the rough tree bark, tear leaves, or even grind some small insect into dust. Just like that, out of half-childish inquisitiveness. It seems to you that all this is yours, it seems normal that man is always insatiable, and nature is always generous. But as soon as you step away from the beaten path, the first delights are replaced by slight fear: are you the master of all this thousand-year-old thicket? And you are already afraid of your loneliness, your insignificance, your weakness in front of the centuries-old pines, because a person has only the knowledge that civilization has given him, and the Pushcha has the memory of all the deeds of man. Belarus, 2010

programme.desc: Hai khám phá tình cờ vào những năm 1950 đã biến những vật liệu công nghiệp tầm thường thành đồ chơi huyền thoại. Etch A Sketch và Play-Doh sẽ thu về hàng tỷ USD trong nhiều thập kỷ tới, nhưng không phải ai cũng gặt hái được thành quả.

programme.title: THE MEGA-BRANDS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S1 EP02

programme.title: THE FOOD THAT BUILT THE WORLD S4 EP32
programme.desc: Hai đối thủ ngũ cốc hạng nặng tranh giành quyền thống trị bữa sáng. Sự cạnh tranh trở nên nóng lên khi một ý tưởng bị đánh cắp, bị tung ra thị trường và thành công vang dội.

programme.title: ALONE S12 EP09
programme.desc: Bị gánh nặng bởi một chuỗi xui xẻo, những người tham gia còn lại nhận thấy cơ hội thành công của họ bắt đầu vụt mất. Một người sống sót giải quyết một nơi trú ẩn đổ nát, trong khi một người khác phải tìm cách tránh chết đói.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S2 EP02

programme.title: THE TOYS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S3 EP03

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP27
programme.desc: Graves, lăng mộ, hỏa táng là những cách tôn trọng để cung cấp cho người chết một nơi an nghỉ. Có thể là một số trong những thực hành này có thể bảo tồn linh hồn vĩnh cửu? Hay đưa người chết trở lại cuộc sống?

programme.title: THE PICKERS S18 EP321
programme.desc: Tại Texas, Retro Rick mở cửa kho tàng di vật Hollywood của mình và Robbie quyết tâm tái hợp hai nửa của quả cầu khí cực hiếm.

programme.title: HIDDEN CITIES S2 EP01
programme.desc: Từ những cuộc chiến tranh bị lãng quên từ lâu đã tàn phá một đế chế Hindu cho đến sự khéo léo của người dân, hãy tìm hiểu về lịch sử bạo lực và sự kiên cường của người Việt Nam.

programme.title: MYSTERIES UNEARTHED WITH DANNY TREJO S1 EP05
programme.desc: Từ một con quái vật thần thoại hóa ra có thật cho đến một trong những loài động vật thời tiền sử nguy hiểm nhất hành tinh, những khám phá đáng kinh ngạc này khiến cả thế giới chấn động và kinh hoàng.

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP06
programme.desc: Đua một cơn bão sắp tới, Darrell Miklos và nhóm của anh ta buộc phải đưa ra những lựa chọn khó khăn. Nhưng sau một cuộc tìm kiếm kéo dài mùa, họ định vị nguồn gốc của từ kế lớn được ghi nhận ở Target 4.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP09
programme.desc: Năm 1587, một nhóm người định cư đổ bộ lên đảo Roanoke ngoài khơi bờ biển Bắc Carolina để thành lập Thuộc địa Anh đầu tiên ở Mỹ. Nhưng chỉ vài năm sau, 115 đàn ông, phụ nữ và trẻ em đều biến mất.

programme.title: THE SECRET OF SKINWALKER RANCH S4 EP04
programme.desc: Nhóm nghiên cứu chuyển sự tập trung trở lại mesa và gần như ngay lập tức nhận được thêm bằng chứng về thứ gì đó được chôn sâu bên trong nó. Và Brandon trở lại trang trại cùng với Bộ trưởng Tư pháp của Utah.

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S16 EP243
programme.desc: Người ngoài hành tinh cổ đại đang đếm ngược mười thảm họa tàn khốc nhất từng được ghi nhận có thể có mối liên hệ với thế giới khác, bao gồm cả quái vật bay trong một sự cố hạt nhân.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE: SERPENT INVASION S3 EP02
programme.desc: Pickle phải đối mặt với nỗi sợ mèo lớn khi tiếp tục gây ấn tượng với Troy bằng tài năng săn rắn của mình. Bill và Tes tình cờ gặp một cơ sở xét nghiệm được đồn đại của chính phủ và tìm thấy tất cả những gì họ có thể xử lý được.

programme.title: THỢ BÁNH THIẾU NIÊN - JUNIOR BAKE OFF
programme.desc: Sức nóng đầu tiên của tám thợ làm bánh cấp dưới bước vào lều Bake Off để thực hiện hai thử thách thú vị. Kỹ năng nướng bánh xốp và làm mứt được kiểm tra trong phần Kỹ thuật phức tạp.

programme.title: CÁC KHÁCH SẠN HÀNG ĐẦU: PHÍA SAU SẢNH - AMAZING HOTELS: LIFE BEYOND THE LOBBY
programme.desc: Monica Galetti và Giles Coren ghé thăm khách sạn Ion Adventure ở Iceland, một khách sạn thiết kế từ một ngọn núi lửa không hoạt động. Khách ghé thăm ở đây mong đợi cuộc phiêu lưu của cả cuộc đời.

programme.title: NHỮNG CĂN NHÀ ĐƯỢC TÂN TRANG CỦA GEORGE CLARK - GEORGE CLARKE'S REMARKABLE RENOVATIONS
programme.desc: Paul và Imogen mở một quán rượu và cửa hàng thịt, với kế hoạch đầy tham vọng nhằm khôi phục tòa nhà được xếp hạng cấp II và bổ sung thêm phần mở rộng bằng kính hiện đại. Nhưng có sự chậm trễ kéo dài và chi phí tốn kém.

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM NGHĨA TÌNH - LOVE PUNCH
programme.desc: Võ sĩ tài năng Jia Yang bị bắt trong một cuộc chiến dưới lòng đất để xóa các khoản nợ của cha cô. Cô mất đi khát vọng Olympic và biến mất khỏi thế giới quyền anh. 10 năm sau, HLV Li Yue quyết tâm giúp cô tôn vinh mong muốn của cha cô bằng cách trở lại võ đài. Khi niềm đam mê và nghĩa vụ va chạm, Jia Yang có thể hồi sinh giấc mơ đấm bốc bị bỏ rơi của mình không?

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình đưa các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào vòng đấm bốc của người nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu nữ đầu tiên của người Thái và mùa 3 có hai huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh cho chức vô địch. Chương trình quyền anh độc đáo này cung cấp giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận đánh thực sự với máu!

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

programme.title: HUYẾT CHIẾN - BURNING BLOOD
programme.desc: Các thành viên của đội chống ma túy—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng và Ah Tang—có liên quan đến việc bắt giữ một trùm ma túy. Tuy nhiên, sự phản bội của cảnh sát đã dẫn đến cái chết của Ah Feng và cấp trên của anh ta, còn Ah Tang thì biến mất. Khi Tai Hua và Lao Mi phát hiện ra sự thật, họ thấy mình bị giằng xé giữa lòng trung thành và sự phản bội trong cuộc chiến chống lại băng đảng ma túy.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!
